title: Xanthine Oxidase Inhibitory Peptides from Sesame 11S Globulin Target the FAD Domain: Kinetics, Molecular Dynamics, and Validation in a Zebrafish Hyperuricemia Model.
authors: Li, Mei-Ling; Huang, Shang-Ming; Lin, Yu-Shun; Wu, Pei-Yu; Chen, Yu-Hsuan; Chuang, Yi-Jing; Yang, Jiann-Jou; Hsu, Kuo-Chiang
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芝麻11S球蛋白来源的XO抑制肽，通过分子对接和MD模拟靶向FAD结构域，虽涉及蛋白-小分子相互作用计算，但核心对象为多肽抑制剂而非蛋白质结构计算问题，方法为常规应用，可迁移性有限。
abstract: Food-derived bioactive peptides are promising alternatives to conventional xanthine oxidase (XO) inhibitors, yet individual XO inhibitory peptides from sesame protein remain uncharacterized. Here, sesame and peanut protein isolates were screened with four proteases; the trypsin hydrolyzate of sesame (TSH, 120 min) showed the highest XO inhibition (47.16%). Eight 11S globulin peptides were identified by nanoUHPLC-ESI-Q-TOF MS/MS. QGDIVAIPSGAAHW (IC50 = 467.2 muM) and AFYLAGGVPR (IC50 = 536.1 muM) exhibited mixed-type inhibition (alpha > 1). Molecular docking against two XO crystal structures (3NVY, 3NRZ) consistently favored the FAD domain, and 500 ns molecular dynamics simulations with MM-GBSA analysis provided convergent support (DeltaG = -160 to -317 kJ mol-1). In a zebrafish hyperuricemia model, TSH reduced uric acid and XO activity while upregulating purine salvage (hprt1) and urate transport (oat1) genes. These findings support sesame-derived peptides as functional food candidates with preferential association with the XO FAD domain.
abstract_zh: 食品源生物活性肽是传统黄嘌呤氧化酶（xanthine oxidase, XO）抑制剂的潜在替代品，但芝麻蛋白中具有XO抑制活性的单个肽尚未被表征。本研究使用四种蛋白酶对芝麻和花生蛋白分离物进行筛选；芝麻胰蛋白酶水解物（TSH，120分钟）表现出最高的XO抑制活性（47.16%）。通过nanoUHPLC-ESI-Q-TOF MS/MS鉴定出八种11S球蛋白肽。QGDIVAIPSGAAHW（IC50 = 467.2 μM）和AFYLAGGVPR（IC50 = 536.1 μM）表现出混合型抑制（α > 1）。针对两种XO晶体结构（3NVY、3NRZ）的分子对接一致倾向于FAD结构域，500 ns分子动力学模拟结合MM-GBSA分析提供了收敛性支持（ΔG = -160至-317 kJ·mol⁻¹）。在斑马鱼高尿酸血症模型中，TSH降低了尿酸水平和XO活性，同时上调了嘌呤补救合成（hprt1）和尿酸盐转运（oat1）基因。这些发现支持芝麻源肽作为功能性食品候选物，其优先与XO的FAD结构域结合。
